recipe.visualDefinition: A serene, misty landscape photograph featuring rolling hills and a field of dry grass, rendered in a muted brown and sepia color palette. Overlaid on this image are two lines of bold, sans-serif white text centered horizontally, with a smaller line of white text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The large white text contrasts strongly with the dark, muted background.
The misty atmosphere creates a soft, blurred background for the sharp text.
The horizontal lines of text align centrally, creating a balanced composition.
The bottom line of text acts as a caption or subtitle to the main title.
coreInvariants: Muted brown and sepia color scheme for the background image.
High contrast white text against the dark background.
Central horizontal alignment for the main text.
Clear distinction between the large main title and the smaller subtitle.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The landscape occupies the entire frame, with the horizon line roughly in the middle. The main text is positioned in the upper-middle section, dominating the visual hierarchy. The smaller text is at the bottom, acting as a footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white text 'BROWN NOISE' serves as the primary visual anchor due to its size, contrast, and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn immediately to the large white text, then scans the misty landscape, and finally settles on the smaller text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The misty sky and the blurred distant hills provide significant negative space around the main text, allowing it to stand out clearly.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The dominant colors are various shades of brown and sepia from the landscape, creating a warm, earthy, and subdued mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White is the primary contrast color, used for all text, ensuring high readability against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None; the image relies on a monochromatic scheme with white text for contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background image has low saturation and moderate to low value, creating a soft, muted appearance. The text is pure white, providing maximum value contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Use only white for text elements.
Avoid bright or highly saturated colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use the same font for both display and caption roles, varying only in size and vertical position to maintain visual consistency and hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric sans-serif with good legibility, similar weight and open counters.
Classic geometric sans-serif, strong presence, and similar letterforms.
Humanist sans-serif with geometric influences, good for display, and similar weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a misty or foggy landscape, preferably with rolling hills or mountains in the background and a field of dry grass or muted vegetation in the foreground. The overall color palette should be dominated by browns, sepia tones, and muted grays, with low saturation. Ensure there is a relatively clear, dark area in the upper-middle section suitable for text overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'BROWN NOISE' in two lines, centered horizontally, in a bold, geometric sans-serif font (e.g., Montserrat Bold or Gotham Bold) and white color. Position it in the upper-middle of the image. Below this, at the very bottom edge of the image, add the caption 'LOOPS FOR RELAXATION, DEEP SLEEP, MEDITATION, AND BABIES' in the same font, color, and bold weight, but at a significantly smaller size, also centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the background image predominantly brown/sepia and misty?
Is the main text 'BROWN NOISE' clearly visible and white?
Is the main text centered horizontally and in the upper-middle?
Is the caption text 'LOOPS FOR RELAXATION, DEEP SLEEP, MEDITATION, AND BABIES' at the bottom, centered, and white?
Are both text elements in a bold, geometric sans-serif font?
Is there sufficient contrast between the text and the background?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of brown/sepia for the background.
Intensity and extent of mist/fog in the landscape.
Exact vertical position of the main text.
Specific geometric sans-serif font used (as long as it meets criteria).

mustAchieve: A sense of calm and tranquility from the landscape.
High readability of all text elements.
avoid: Text that blends into the background.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the background image evokes a calm, natural atmosphere.
Confirm that all text is crisp, white, and stands out against the background.
Check that the main title is prominently displayed and easy to read.
Ensure the caption is legible despite its smaller size.
Confirm the overall composition feels balanced and serene.
Check for any unintended artifacts or distortions in the text or image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Generate a muted, low-saturation landscape image (e.g., misty mountains, foggy field) with a dominant brown/sepia palette. Overlay a large, bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif title, centered in the upper-middle. Add a smaller, bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif caption, centered at the bottom.
